semantic_invariants: scene SHA-256 equals model.scene_sha256 before model compilation
after mj_forward, virtual_cup geom_xpos equals its camera-derived world position
after mj_forward, virtual_cup center expressed in wrist_cam coordinates equals cup.center_in_camera_coordinates_m
pass_conditions: all fresh-process attempts satisfy both semantic invariants
all fresh-process attempts render one or more virtual_cup segmentation pixels
all fresh-process attempts have identical target-pixel counts and segmentation SHA-256 values
stop_conditions: any attempt has zero target pixels
target-pixel count or segmentation SHA-256 differs between attempts

non_claims: This establishes only a candidate-model golden case for the stated fixed relative pose and current recorded runtime.
It does not reproduce or explain any earlier raster table, validate a visibility proxy, or establish a workspace coverage boundary.
It does not establish physical camera calibration, RGB perception, collision safety, reachability, grasping, control, sim-to-real, or multi-robot capability.
